  id = {EDN-94},
  title = {CD deploys releases through a VM runner that may only run \texorpdfstring{\texttt{deploy.\allowbreak{}sh}}{deploy.sh}},
  note = {\textbf{Revised on 2026-11-04}: a release now carries its stack files (\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/279}{\#279}).},
  date = {2026-10-30},
  milestone = {M5: Model Packaging},
  topic = {CI/CD, Deployment, Security},
  participants = {Lukas Häußler decided (\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/198}{issue \#198}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/279}{issue \#279}); AI agents proposed the options in \#279 and implemented them},
  decision = {A self-hosted runner on the VM, outside the \texttt{docker} group, runs the deploy and rollback jobs; sudo lets it run \texttt{deploy.\allowbreak{}sh} with its three commands only.
\texttt{deploy.\allowbreak{}sh} pulls the API and stack images of one tag with the job's token, copies the stack files beside \texttt{.\allowbreak{}env}, and a rollback restores both.
The smoke check runs on a GitHub-hosted runner.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item SSH from a GitHub-hosted runner: the VM's SSH port answers only from the UPC network.
\item The smoke check on the VM runner: no outside view.
\item Stack files copied by hand: a person on the VPN per merge, unnoticed drift, no rollback.
\item Copying them from a checkout: repository content on the runner.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} Only an outbound connection from the VM works: from outside the UPC network, its SSH port timed out (\#134).
No repository code runs on the runner: \texttt{deploy.\allowbreak{}sh} copies the stack files out of a never-started container of an image CD pushed after the API image's checks.
Fork pull requests' workflows need a team member's approval, and a test keeps other workflows off the runner.},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI laid out the options for reaching the VM, the private package and the stack files, and recommended the chosen ones; @lukas2510 took them, leaving open the stack files' carrier, for which AI chose an image of its own (EDN-91).
AI wrote the workflows, scripts and drill tests; in an Ubuntu 20.04 container, sudo 1.8.31 refused every other command tried, and GHCR answers \texttt{manifest unknown} for a missing tag.},
